LanguageData.TDK_MessageStaring: {ANIMAL_labelShort} is staring at something you can't see.
LanguageData.TDK_Setting_Message: Message when an animal starts staring
LanguageData.TDK_Setting_Message_Desc: Show a short message pointing at the animal (at most one every in-game hour per map). The animal still stares and growls without it.
LanguageData.TDK_Setting_Growl_Desc: The animal growls, low, at the start of the stare and halfway through.
